sam: Quick heads-up — planning a small schema change and backfill tonight.

sam: Details: add nullable column `source_id` to `events` and create matview `events_agg_v2` to replace slow query. Backfill ~2M rows, estimate 90m if chunked.

jess: What window? any locks? :eyes:

sam: Target 02:00–04:00 UTC Tue. Migration is ADD COLUMN (no lock) + CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY.

sam: Backfill will be chunked with id ranges and `UPDATE ... WHERE source_id IS NULL` — no exclusive locks expected but we need to watch replica lag.

miguel: Can you paste the chunking script you'll run? Want to review retry/backoff.

sam: Sure — rough script:

```sql
-- chunked update
BEGIN;
UPDATE events e
SET source_id = src.val
FROM (SELECT id, computed_source() AS val FROM events WHERE source_id IS NULL AND id >= %d AND id < %d) src
WHERE e.id = src.id;
COMMIT;
```

sam: We'll run with `pg_sleep(0.2)` between chunks and monitor lag.

jess: Also add a feature-flag gate: only enable new matview reads for 10% of traffic first. If things spike, rollback by pointing queries back to old view.

deploy-bot: migration job queued: migration/1835001123_add_source_id (estimated duration: 120m). Scheduled start: 1835004800.

anya: FYI oncall will be watching. I'll have runbooks open and alert thresholds: replica_lag > 30s, long txn > 2m, bloat > 10%.

miguel: If replica lag exceeds 15s, pause backfill and assess. Also consider running CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY to avoid blocking writes.

sam: Agreed. I'll include a dry-run on staging tomorrow and post results.

jess: LGTM. Please post final runbook link when ready. :thumbsup:

sam: Will do — pinging again when I push the migration manifest.
